task.title: M0: Bun workspace, node-target build, and CI matrix
task.description:
Stand up the monorepo skeleton described in docs/design.md: a Bun workspace with packages core, analyzers, cli, and web, a bun build --target=node step that produces the single bundled ESM CLI entry, and a CI workflow that runs the (initially empty) test suite under both current Bun and Node 20 LTS. Runtime code must only use node:* APIs; Bun.* and bun:* are confined to dev scripts. This is the foundation every later story builds on, so keep it minimal and boring.

Acceptance criteria:
- packages/core, packages/analyzers, packages/cli, and packages/web exist as workspace members with their own package.json and tsconfig.
- bun install succeeds from a clean clone and bun test passes with zero tests.
- bun run build emits a single ESM bundle for the CLI via bun build --target=node, and node dist/cli.js --version runs under Node 20.
- A lint/check step fails the build if runtime packages import Bun.* or bun:* modules.
- CI runs the test suite on a matrix of current Bun and Node 20 and is green on main.
- README documents the workspace layout and the dev commands.
